thresholds.heat_threshold_note: Heat threshold is a team assumption, not a validated agronomic value. Edit config.json (heat_threshold_c) or regions.json.

missing_data_policy: Fill values (-999, -99) are converted to null; nothing is imputed. Rain totals scale observed days to the full window. Heat days count observed days only (lower bound). Dry spells are broken by missing days (lower bound). Baselines skip null days.

quality.confidence_note: Heuristic from missing data, baseline length and partial season. Treat low as 'insufficient data' in scoring.
